Diogène vivait dans un pithos, une jarre: Diogenes lived in a pithos, an earthenware jar. Alexander the Great supposedly asked him what he wanted; he supposedly replied: “Stand out of my sunlight.”
Le mythe d'un Moyen Âge persuadé que la: The myth of a Middle Ages convinced the Earth was flat owes much to Washington Irving's fictionalized biography of Columbus, in 1828. Medieval scholars opposed Columbus over the size of the Earth, and they were right: he had underestimated it.
« Je désapprouve ce que vous dites, mais: “I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it” is by Evelyn Beatrice Hall, in The Friends of Voltaire (1906). She was summing up Voltaire's thinking, and had to clarify it herself in 1939.
Maîtriser les philosophes modernes. Votr: Master the modern philosophers. Your achievement is provisional, like any scientific theory.
Le critère de la scientificité d'une thé: The criterion of the scientific status of a theory is its falsifiability, or refutability, or testability.
Master the first diamond of Wisdom. You now know that you know nothing, but with references.
I know that I know nothing.
Réussir 3 quiz de Sagesse sans faute. Vo: Pass 3 Wisdom quizzes without a mistake. You finally see the objects, not their shadows.
Platon place l'allégorie de la caverne a: Plato places the allegory of the cave in Book VII of the Republic. According to tradition, he had “Let no one ignorant of geometry enter here” inscribed over the door of the Academy. The phrase is only attested nearly nine centuries later.
Maîtriser 9 compétences. L'arbre de la P: Master 9 skills. The Philosophy tree opens.
Une vie sans examen ne vaut pas d'être v: The unexamined life is not worth living.
Maîtriser l'éthique. Vous pouvez tirer l: Master ethics. You can pull the lever or do nothing. The AI has already chosen.
Le dilemme du tramway, qui fonce sur cin: The trolley dilemma, hurtling toward five people unless you throw a switch toward just one, was posed in 1967 by the philosopher Philippa Foot, in a paper on abortion. The name “trolley problem” comes from Judith Jarvis Thomson, in 1976.
Maîtriser la philosophie politique. La f: Master political philosophy. The end doesn't justify made-up quotes.
« La fin justifie les moyens » ne figure: “The end justifies the means” appears nowhere in Machiavelli. In The Prince, he writes that in politics, with no court to appeal to, a prince is judged by his results. The more brutal phrase is a summary by his opponents.
Maîtriser la philosophie de l'esprit. Vo: Master the philosophy of mind. Your cells change, so do your memories. Are you still you?
Selon Plutarque, les Athéniens remplaçai: According to Plutarch, the Athenians replaced the rotten planks of Theseus's ship one by one: was it still the same ship? Hobbes, in 1655, sharpens the question: if someone rebuilds a ship from the old planks, which of the two is the real one?
Maîtriser la philosophie des sciences. C: Master the philosophy of science. Shift your paradigm. Which one? Take your pick.
Thomas Kuhn popularise en 1962 le mot «: Thomas Kuhn popularized the word “paradigm” in 1962. In 1970, the philosopher Margaret Masterman found twenty-one different senses of the word in his book. Kuhn acknowledged it, and came to prefer “disciplinary matrix”.
Maîtriser les sagesses hellénistiques. L: Master Hellenistic wisdom. The AI gives you back your jar.
Maîtriser la scolastique. Christophe Col: Master scholasticism. Christopher Columbus convinced nobody the Earth was round: everybody knew.
Maîtriser les Lumières. L'IA désapprouve: Master the Enlightenment. The AI disapproves of your quotes, but lets you say them.
Maîtriser les présocratiques. Empédocle: Master the Pre-Socratics. Empedocles left a sandal; you, at least, leave answers.
D'après Diogène Laërce, Empédocle se ser: According to Diogenes Laërtius, Empedocles threw himself into Etna so that people would think he had become a god. The volcano threw back one of his bronze sandals, giving the trick away.
Maîtriser les sagesses d'Asie. La mère d: Master the wisdom of Asia. Mencius' mother would have moved fewer times for you.
Selon les Biographies des femmes exempla: According to Liu Xiang's Biographies of Exemplary Women, Mencius' mother lived near a cemetery, where the child imitated burials, then near a market, where he imitated the merchants. She finally settled near a school: he began to study.
Maîtriser Socrate et Platon. Aristophane: Master Socrates and Plato. Aristophanes would have hung you in a basket too.
Dans Les Nuées, jouée en 423 av. J.-C.,: In The Clouds, staged in 423 BC, Aristophanes shows Socrates hanging in a basket to observe the sky better. The play came last in the contest; yet Plato cites it among the causes of Socrates' trial.
Maîtriser Aristote. Une compétence ne fa: Master Aristotle. One skill does not make a spring, but it's a start.
Pour Aristote, le bonheur se juge sur un: For Aristotle, happiness is judged over a whole life: "one swallow does not make a spring". The phrase comes from the Nicomachean Ethics.
Maîtriser les philosophes de Rome. Notez: Master the philosophers of Rome. Write it down for yourself alone; the AI will read over your shoulder.
Marc Aurèle n'a pas donné de titre à ses: Marcus Aurelius gave his Meditations no title: the manuscript reads "To himself". It is unlikely he meant to publish them.
Maîtriser les philosophes de l'Islam. Ap: Master the philosophers of Islam. After Aristotle and al-Farabi, the AI grants you third place.
Al-Farabi était appelé le « second maîtr: Al-Farabi was called the "Second Master", after Aristotle. Avicenna said he did not properly understand Aristotle's Metaphysics until he had read an introduction by al-Farabi.
Maîtriser la Renaissance. Pic de la Mira: Master the Renaissance. Pico della Mirandola defended nine hundred; you, a few.
En 1486, à 23 ans, Pic de la Mirandole p: In 1486, aged 23, Pico della Mirandola offered to defend 900 theses in Rome and to pay the travel of anyone who came to debate them. The pope suspended the debate; the book became the first printed book banned everywhere by the Church.
Maîtriser l'âge classique. Personne ne v: Master the classical age. Nobody has summoned you at five in the morning. Not yet.
En 1649, la reine Christine de Suède fai: In 1649, Queen Christina of Sweden brought Descartes to Stockholm in midwinter and asked for lessons three times a week, at five in the morning. He contracted pneumonia and died on 11 February 1650.
